div.div: خَزُومَةٌ i. q. بَقَرَةٌ [app. as meaning both A bull and a cow], (JK, S, K,) in the dial. of Hudheyl; (S;) or such as is advanced in age, and short: (M, K:) pl. ↓ خَزُومٌ , [or rather this is a coll. gen. n.,] and [the pl. is] خَزَائِمُ (JK, K) and خَزُومَاتٌ (S) and [quasi-pl. n.] ↓ خَزَمٌ . (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
